summary: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund, a non-listed BDC, filed an Item 8.01 8-K reporting routine monthly NAV and offering prices. Class I and Class D NAV were $23.85 per share and Class S $23.77 as of August 31, 2026, with aggregate NAV about $1.5 billion, portfolio fair value $3.3 billion and $1.8 billion secured borrowings. Third-quarter gross subscriptions totaled roughly $58.0 million; approximately 1.3% of shares were tendered in the repurchase offer expiring September 28, 2026, priced at September 30 NAV. The board declared regular distributions payable October 28, 2026. No special-situation event; watch repurchase-offer results and NAV drift.
